682:t_1:83.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Are you saying the $$御使い$$ have abandoned the $$サイデリアル$$ under their command?」

682:t_1:84.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Judging by the situation, that would be the case.」

682:t_1:85.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If we had their combat strength... we could even fight the $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

682:t_1:86.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't rely on guys like that. We'll carve out our future with our own strength.」

682:t_1:87.en:
$$勝平$$
「Even the world Sis $$ノリコ$$ came from beat the $$宇宙怪獣$$! We can do it too, so let's go for it!」

682:t_1:90.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...The scale of the $$宇宙怪獣$$ this time... is far bigger than the ones in our world.」

682:t_1:92.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Judging by their territory and distribution map, I'd say it's more than five times the scale of the ones in our world.」

682:t_1:93.en:
$$トライア$$
「...No point in sugarcoating it. I'm sending over the footage the recon fleet transmitted.」

682:t_1:98.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's the $$宇宙怪獣$$, as you can see.」

682:t_1:99.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So every spot that looks like a stain is a swarm of them?」

682:t_1:100.en:
$$シャア$$
「Over 80 percent of our field of view is filled, huh... Is this a level that 10 billion wouldn't cover?」

682:t_1:102.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「If we lose to that, it's not just humanity... the whole universe will be finished...」

682:t_1:107.en:
$$アルト$$
「We knew it would be a tough fight before we even left Earth.」

682:t_1:108.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm not about to get cold feet now.」

682:t_1:109.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah...! If losing means it's over, then we'll just hit them with everything, literally risking our lives.」

682:t_1:110.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I mustn't run away... Moving forward... that's the only way...」

682:t_1:111.en:
$$かなめ$$
「They're strong, everyone in the Volunteer Club.」

682:t_1:112.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They've kept fighting of their own free will, with no reward at all. I think that spirit is what's alive right now.」

682:t_1:113.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...That hits a little close to home...」

682:t_1:114.en:
$$トライア$$
「You ruin the whole mood, you know. Your existence, I mean.」

682:t_1:115.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...The nest of the $$宇宙怪獣$$... The Great Attractor Elimination Operation is...」

682:t_1:116.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The first phase is to advance the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 as far as possible to the galactic center, where they emerge.」

682:t_1:117.en:
$$トライア$$
「And then we set off the $$時空震動弾|lc$$.」

682:t_1:118.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$宇宙怪獣$$ in the surrounding area will be held off by the Galactic Raid Fleet and our other partners, including the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, but even so, the enemy will keep coming.」

682:t_1:119.en:
$$シャア$$
「Seven minutes from activation to detonation... Our mission is to hold the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3's final line of defense at all costs.」

682:t_1:120.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The future of all the parallel worlds depends on this operation...」

682:t_1:121.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I'm sorry... Give me everyone's lives.」

682:t_1:122.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no need to apologize, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

682:t_1:123.en:
$$シン$$
「We've been ready for this for a long time now.」

682:t_1:124.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But I don't plan on dying, either. I want to meet the future with $$ティファ$$.」

682:t_1:125.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We're not like the force that seeks to vanish. Let's properly find out for ourselves what the new era... the future holds.」

682:t_1:126.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You're right. Then let me rephrase that.」

682:t_1:127.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I order everyone to come back alive! Protect the future, and we will return alive, without fail!」

682:t_1:131.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It's all right, $$ノノ$$. Princess will definitely come...」

682:t_1:132.en:
$$カシオ$$
「That's right. Fighting the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is the duty of $$フラタニティ$$ and the mission of the $$バスターマシン$$s, after all.」

682:t_1:134.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ラルク$$ and the others in the second wave of the Galactic Raid Fleet will surely be a force that helps us.」

682:t_1:135.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Until then, let's do our best with our own strength!」

682:t_1:138.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ wanted to be like you, $$ノリコ$$...」

682:t_2:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ダイバスター$$ stopped the Earth... stopped $$ドゥーズミーユ$$!」

682:t_2:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「Look! The ether flow accelerator that dragged the Earth all the way here is transforming into a humanoid!」

682:t_2:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So that's Princess's $$トップレス$$ power!」

682:t_2:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Get out of the way, No. 7!! Don't get in my way!!」

682:t_2:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't rely on you when I don't even know where you came from! This is humanity's fight!」

682:t_2:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Humanity will survive even if it means abandoning the Earth! I don't know whether that's right or not...! You have nothing to do with it!」

682:t_2:10.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You, who don't even know how I feel...! You!!」

682:t_2:12.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If you'd just stayed my friend, that would have been enough! I wanted you to call me $$ラルク$$, not Big Sis!」

682:t_2:13.en:
$$ラルク$$
「And yet you! You kept getting stronger all by yourself, and left me behind...!」

682:t_2:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I... I can't be the one you look up to! I can't be $$ノノリリ$$!」

682:t_2:17.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Not being able to become $$ノノリリ$$... is the same for $$ノノ$$...」

682:t_2:19.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ wanted to be like you, Big Sis... I've always envied you...」

682:t_2:20.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because... you look so much like $$ノノリリ$$, Big Sis...」

682:t_2:22.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You see, $$ノノリリ$$ isn't special... She's just an ordinary girl...」

682:t_2:23.en:
$$ベック$$
「Tsk, tsk, tsk... That's not it, little lady.」

682:t_2:24.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ベック$$! Why are you here!?」

682:t_2:25.en:
$$ベック$$
「Why? Because yours truly is a member of the Galactic Raid Fleet's second wave too.」

682:t_2:28.en:
$$ベック$$
「The circumstances can wait until later.」
